title: Why won’t 2100 be a leap year?

sources.name: NASA Space Place — What Is a Leap Year?

practice: Try General Knowledge for more questions about dates, discoveries and the world around us.

sections.html:
2100 will not be a leap year because it is divisible by 100 but not by 400. The year 2000 was divisible by 400, so it did have an extra day in February.

In the Gregorian calendar, being divisible by four is only the first test. Years ending in 00 need one more check.
sections.title: The exception to the four-year rule

sections.html:
A seasonal year lasts about 365.2422 days. If every calendar year had exactly 365 days, the calendar would gradually drift away from the seasons.

Adding a day every four years gets close, but adds slightly too much time. Skipping some century leap years makes the calendar’s average year a better match.
sections.title: Why we need leap days

sections.html:
1. Is the year divisible by four? If not, it is a common year.
  2. Is it divisible by 100? If not, it is a leap year.
  3. For a century year, is it divisible by 400? If so, it is a leap year; otherwise, it is not.

So 2028 is a leap year, 2100 is not, and 2400 will be.
sections.title: Three checks to remember

sections.html:
Which of these years have 366 days in the Gregorian calendar: 2027, 2032, 2200 and 2400?

Show the answers

2032 and 2400. The first is divisible by four and is not a century year. The second is divisible by 400. Meanwhile, 2027 is not divisible by four, and 2200 fails the 400 test.

questions.prompt: Which rule applies to century years in the Gregorian calendar?
questions.explanation: A year divisible by 100 is a leap year only when it is also divisible by 400.

questions.prompt: Which of these was or will be a leap year?
questions.explanation: 2000 is divisible by 400. The other three century years are not.

questions.prompt: Why does the calendar need leap-year corrections?
options: The seasonal year is not exactly 365 days
February changes the speed of Earth
Every month should have equal length
The Moon makes years exactly 366 days
questions.explanation: Leap rules help keep calendar dates aligned with the seasons because the seasonal year is a little longer than 365 days.
